title: Stripe
description: Crisp white page framed by faint blue-grey hairlines, deep navy ink, one indigo for every action, and a deep-navy sibling. A light grotesk at weight 300, small 4–6px corners, a warm orange–pink–violet ribbon spectrum for art.
notes: light is the faithful mode; the stripe developer blocks force their dark band with the dark class
Hanken Grotesk stands in for Stripe's own (closed) Söhne; headings and body are set at weight 300
